encounter.title: Prologue 2 — free the arrow — PROVISIONAL (shortlist #1, seed 300)
encounter.notes: EXP-009 demo only, not chosen by the user. tiny 4 arrows, target E, 2 hp, free-at-start N/E/S/W 0/1/0/0. One E arrow starts blocked and visible next to the free one, on purpose: docs/COMBAT-RULES.md 9 assigns this slot to 'blocked tap now costs HP', which EXP-009 does not implement (no player HP / no damage yet, so a blocked tap here is still free to try).
